tools.name: get_account_state
tools.description: Return the authorized advertising account, workspace, connection, Signal destination, and currently available account capabilities. This read-only inspection tool does not change the account.

tools.name: get_account_inventory
tools.description: Read the authorized workspace account inventory from the Meta mirror, with optional level, status, parent, and ID cursor filters.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces and effective access tiers in this credential scope.

tools.name: get_signal_health
tools.description: Diagnostic view of first-party event flow, Meta delivery outcomes, match quality, and reconciliation gaps from Plainrouter stored measurements. Not admissible evidence for spend-affecting proposals. Does not call the Marketing API.

tools.name: get_performance
tools.description: Admissible proposal evidence: reconciliation meta_reported is the existing Meta-reported conversions count compared with gateway_verified accepted conversions. The separate purchases block shows Meta-reported Purchase counts under the account attribution setting beside Plainrouter accepted server-si

tools.name: get_inventory_metrics
tools.description: Read daily Meta metrics beside counted PlainRouter arrivals for mirrored campaigns, ad sets and ads. object_metrics contains account-timezone daily comparisons; unmatched_arrivals is one workspace/window count without unknown IDs. Counts are null when the arrivals store is disabled. Optional change

tools.name: verify_signal_ingestion
tools.description: Verify server-side Signal ingestion by writing one idempotent, identity-free modeled event for the authorized workspace. This confirms ledger receipt but does not count as real arrival evidence or complete onboarding. No spend capability.

tools.name: propose-actions
tools.description: Propose a batch of budget, status, upload, or creative-duplication actions for the approved ad account. In Ask, every policy-allowed change waits for a person to approve it. In Full, policy-allowed changes run automatically. Rule violations are blocked and shown in the Inbox, and cannot be approved.

tools.name: dry_run_actions
tools.description: Preview policy decisions and execution diffs for a proposed Action batch without writing it.

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: List proposed actions for the authorized workspace and advertising account.

tools.name: get_action_batch
tools.description: Get a proposed action batch for the authorized workspace and advertising account. Each action’s counted_evidence contains frozen proposal-time target figures and coverage; null means not captured.

tools.name: get_action
tools.description: Get one proposed action for the authorized workspace and advertising account. counted_evidence contains frozen target figures and coverage captured at proposal time; null means not captured. The figures inform and never gate.

tools.name: get_action_decision_receipt
tools.description: Get the persisted decision receipt for an authorized proposed action. Version 3 receipts include counted_evidence frozen at proposal time with account-currency values, coverage and the other-currency exclusion. Existing receipts are unchanged.

tools.name: get_action_policy
tools.description: Get the effective Actions policy for the authorized workspace without creating a policy row.

tools.name: actions.rules.list
tools.description: List stored performance rules available to this workspace key. This does not evaluate them.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
